obernants.domain: Finite deterministic fixtures and test executions; no arbitrary programs or hidden production state.
obernants.assumptions: Rust byte-slice semantics and successful allocation; transformation premises as stated.
obernants.operator: Exclude acceptance when an asserted production output differs from the independent oracle, a stated conditional law fails under its premises, or a compatible-output fiber differs from direct constraints. Unvisited inputs are outside this finite acceptance claim.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation; bounded checks are not universal proofs.
